company.name: Mashgin
company.shortDescription: Mashgin is a software company that makes AI and computer vision checkout systems.
company.description: Mashgin's builds A.I. based self-checkout systems that are deployed widely across thousands of locations including most of the top stadiums, airports and venues in the United States. The technology is also deployed widely across thousands of gas stations and convenience stores in the US. The company was founded in 2014 and is based in Palo Alto, California. Mashgin is growing and is extremely profitable.

productsAndServices.description: An AI and computer vision-based self-checkout system that recognizes items placed on a tray to speed up transactions without barcode scanning.

aiResearchSummary.text: Mashgin is researching a method and system for item identification that determines visual information, computes encodings, and outputs an item identifier, and an automated object recognition kiosk for retail checkouts that uses a controller and imaging device. It develops a system and method for identifying items via point clouds, region masks, and surface reconstruction, separation of objects in images from three dimensional cameras, and a multi batch self checkout system and method of use.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $62,500,000, or 84.81% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,848,565 to $1,500,000,000, a 526.58x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
